content.text:
The two labels are strongly associated, so a causal link is more likely than none.

- Among patients with R intracapular problems, 35.7% have L C5 radiculopathy (81 of 227).
- Among patients without R intracapular problems, 13.1% have L C5 radiculopathy (2,120 of 16,157).

The data can't show the direction of the link. I chose it on domain grounds: radiculopathy is a nerve-root pathology, and intracapular problems are a downstream symptom or pain region. I've read "intracapular" in the column name as intrascapular. So L C5 radiculopathy causing R intracapular problems is more plausible than the reverse.

ANSWER: B
